basis: Remaining 48 state-years after Rhode Island, New Hampshire, Utah and Vermont. Task-hours per source TB are whole task time (image pull to stop, Spot rework included) on image v4, which builds overviews from full resolution: 60 cm 6.5 (nh2025-pub-2, 12 tasks, no interruption) and 7.9 (ut2024-pub-2, 51 tasks, 3 interruptions); 30 cm 8.1 (vt2025-pub-1, 40 tasks, 10 interruptions). Spot rates per vCPU-hour, GB-hour and address-hour from the Utah bill of 2026-11-10. 2 GiB tasks for 60 cm, 4 GiB for 30 cm (peak 1.2 GiB on Vermont). Request lines carried over from estimate @2. The high case takes Utah speed for all 60 cm and 30 cm 17% slower than Vermont.
